settings.warnOverDetail: A note on home, nothing stops working.

remedy.consentNoticeSuperseded: The consent wording changed while you were with the doctor. Open consent again, read the current notice aloud, and ask once more.
remedy.consentCapturedInFuture: This phone's clock is ahead of the server, so the consent looks like it happened in the future. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again.
remedy.consentTooOld: This consent was captured too long ago to be accepted now. Connect and sync sooner after a visit — your manager can tell you the limit for your territory.
remedy.recordingInFuture: This phone's clock is ahead of the server, so the recording looks like it happened in the future. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again — the recording itself is fine.
remedy.recordingTooOld: This recording was made too long ago to be accepted now, and waiting will not change that. Connect and sync sooner after a visit — your manager can tell you the limit for your territory.
remedy.fieldEventInFuture: This phone's clock is ahead of the server, so the check-in or check-out looks like it happened in the future. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again — the visit itself is fine.
remedy.checkOutBeforeCheckIn: The check-out is timed before the check-in, so the phone's clock changed during the visit. Turn on automatic date and time in Settings, then send again.
remedy.workDayClosed: You ended your working day for this date, so nothing more can be checked in on it. If this visit really happened that day, ask your manager to reopen the day — then send again.
remedy.workDayHasOpenVisit: A visit is still checked in. Check out of it, then end your day again.
remedy.ucpmpSampleCapExceeded: This would go past the UCPMP limit for this doctor this month. Do not hand anything else over — speak to your manager first.
remedy.outsideShiftWindow: This was recorded outside your territory’s working hours. If the hours are wrong, your manager can change them.
remedy.shiftWindowNotConfigured: Your territory has no working hours set, so nothing can be recorded against it yet. Your manager or an administrator has to set them.
remedy.fallback: The server refused this without a reason the app can show. Report the code below to support.
errors.sessionExpiredDetail: Sign out and sign in again from Me to bring this up to date.
errors.signInExpired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign out and sign in again from Me.
errors.notPermitted: Your account can’t open this. If you think it should, tell your manager.
errors.turnedDown: This was turned down. If it keeps happening, tell your manager.
errors.noSignal: No signal, or the server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.ourSide: Something went wrong on our side. Try again — if it keeps happening, tell your manager.
sync.queueUnreadable: This app could not read your queue, so it cannot tell you what has been sent. Nothing has been lost from the server — but nothing on this screen is confirmed either. Tell your manager if it persists.
day.noServerClock: This app has not been able to ask the server what day it is, so it cannot tell which period to show you. It will try again when you come back to it.
dayEnd.captureNote: This app only ever reads your position at the moment you press check in or check out. It has not been reading it between visits, it is not reading it now, and it will not until you press again.
dayEnd.afterEnd: When you end it, the server keeps your day as it stands and refuses further check-ins for today unless your manager reopens it.
dayEnd.serverHasDayAttended: The server has your day: {attended} of {total} visits attended.
dayEnd.furtherRefused: Further check-ins for today are refused unless your manager reopens the day.
dayEnd.endingSent: Ending your day — the server has it
dayEnd.endingSentDetail: Its confirmation arrives with your next sync.
dayEnd.endingQueued: Ended on this phone — waiting to send
dayEnd.endingQueuedDetail: It sends by itself when you have signal, after anything else still waiting. Nothing is lost.
dayEnd.startedOnPhone: Your day is started on this phone — waiting to send
dayEnd.startsWithCheckIn: It starts with your first check-in.
dayEnd.openVisits_one: A visit is still checked in. Check out of it first, then end your day.
dayEnd.openVisits_other: {count} visits are still checked in. Check out of them first, then end your day.
dayEnd.rateNote: Distance only. Your rate per kilometre is set by your company and this app has not been given it, so the amount comes from payroll rather than from here.
dayEnd.noDay: Could not confirm which day this is
dayEnd.noAccess: You do not have access to this day
dayEnd.title: {day} — that's the day
dayEnd.visitsUnavailable: Not available — the day could not be fetched.
dayEnd.allOfThem: you went to all of them
dayEnd.notMet_one: One doctor was not available. That is recorded against the visit, not against you.
dayEnd.notMet_other: {count} doctors were not available. That is recorded against those visits, not against you.
dayEnd.distanceUnavailable: Distance not available — it could not be fetched.
dayEnd.noteHelp: Optional. Your manager sees it with your day.

tracking.permissionDeniedDetail: Allow location for this app in your phone’s settings, or stop sharing for today.
tracking.lastFailed: Your last position did not reach your company. It is not kept to send later.
data.noteTitle: This app has sent {size} over mobile data this month
data.noteDetail: That is its uploads only — not downloads, and not other apps. Nothing has stopped working.
day.zoneCaveat: Dates and times are shown in UTC. This app could not get your territory’s timezone, so a day here may not be the day you worked — in India it runs 5 hours 30 minutes behind.

sync.unsentBeforeSignOut_other: {count} things have not been sent yet
sync.unsentBeforeSignOutDetail: They stay on this phone under your account and send the next time you sign in here. Nobody else who signs in on this phone will see or send them.

pending.heading: Pending sync
pending.lead: Day will be confirmed after sync.
today.stopsLeftDetail: No visit has started for them yet. See today’s route for who is left.
today.noPlanDetail: No beat plan came through. You can still visit anyone in your territory and it'll all be logged.
today.everyoneDetail: You went to every visit on the plan.
today.everyoneNotMet_one: You went to every visit on the plan. One doctor was not available.

visit.notOnYourPhoneDetail: It may still be syncing, or it may no longer be yours. Pull down on Today to sync, and if it does not appear, ask your manager.

visit.doctorNotSyncedDetail: The visit is here but the doctor’s details are not. Give it a moment and try again — nothing is lost.

visit.doctorWithdrew: The doctor agreed and then changed their mind. Nothing more can be recorded for this visit.
visit.recordingQuarantined: This visit is being checked after a problem with the server’s records. Recording is off until somebody clears it.
visit.microphoneOff: The microphone is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings if you want to record with the doctor’s agreement.

report.sentDetail: Your manager sees this next time they open your visits.
report.savedDetail: Saved on this phone. It will send by itself when you have signal — you do not have to retype it.
report.keepOpen: Keep this screen open — the note is not saved yet.
report.sendNote: Write what happened first. The other two are optional.

report.objectionsHelp: Anything they pushed back on. Leave it empty if there was nothing.
report.productsHelp: Mark each one you talked about. None is fine if none came up.
samples.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to this visit
samples.loadFailedDetail: The app could not reach the server. It will try again.
samples.queuedDetail: {n} saved on this phone. They will send by themselves when you have signal — nothing is lost.
samples.errorName: Name what you left, as it reads on the pack — "Elmiron 100 mg, 30s".
samples.errorQuantity: Use the plus key to set how many you left. It cannot be fewer than one.
samples.errorValue: Put the declared value of one pack in rupees — digits only, like 240 or 240.50.
samples.capNote: This app does not count your samples against the UCPMP cap — nothing in it has been given your limit or your month to date. Keep your own count, and check with your manager before you go near it.
samples.recordNote: Signed for on delivery. Saves on this phone if you have no signal.
samples.title: Leave samples
samples.itemHelp: Exactly as it reads on the pack, so your manager can match it.
samples.valueHelp: What your company declares one of these to be worth. Ask your manager if you are not sure — this goes on the record as your declaration.
voiceNote.notHereDetail: This visit is not on this phone, so there is nothing to save the note against. Nothing you record here is kept.
voiceNote.sent: Sent. The note has reached the company, so it is no longer kept on this phone.
voiceNote.queued: Saved on this phone. It will send by itself when you have signal, and is then removed from this phone.

voiceNote.queueUnreadable: Saved on this phone, but it could not be put in line to send, so it will not send by itself.
voiceNote.waitingForWifi: Saved on this phone. It will send by itself when this phone is on WiFi, and is then removed from this phone. To send it sooner, open the list of things waiting to send.
voiceNote.hint: Try covering — what they asked, what you promised, what to do next time.
voiceNote.prompt: What should I put in the report?
voiceNote.olderRemoved_one: 1 older note could not be sent — they were saved before sending existed, so the visit was not recorded with them. They have been removed from this phone.

mileage.straightLines: Measured in straight lines between the visits you checked into, so it counts less than the roads you actually rode.
mileage.noneDetail: Distance appears once you have checked into more than one visit.
mileage.rateNote: Your rate per kilometre is set by your company, and this app has not been given it. Distance here is what your claim is calculated from; the amount comes from payroll.
mileage.whichMonth: Could not tell which month to show
mileage.noAccess: You do not have access to this mileage
dataSettings.title: Mobile data
dataSettings.saveFailedDetail: This phone could not save it. The switch shows what is still in effect.
dataSettings.wifiOnlyExplain: Voice notes and visit recordings wait while this phone is on mobile data, or cannot tell which network it is on. They stay safe on this phone, and you can still send them from the list of things waiting to send.
dataSettings.warnOverExplain: Counts what this app uploads over mobile data each month, by India’s date: your audio and the work you send. Downloads, other apps and the phone’s own use are not counted, so your plan’s total will be higher.
dataSettings.usedLabel: This app’s uploads over mobile data this month
dataSettings.usedUnknown: Shown once this phone has synced today.
transparency.openAnyTime: Open this any time from home.
transparency.notYet: Not yet — this app cannot do this today.
transparency.neverRecorded: Your calls, messages, contacts, camera or other apps: this app has no permission to reach them. And nothing in the background: your position is read only at the moment you press check in or check out.
transparency.neverRecordedLive: Your calls, messages, contacts, camera or other apps: this app has no permission to reach them. And nothing in the background: your position is read when you press check in or check out, and, only if you agreed to share live location, every few minutes during your working hours while the app is on your screen.
transparency.checkInLocation: Where you are, when you check in or out
transparency.checkInLocationDetail: One position each time you press check in or check out, and how far that was from the clinic. Never in the background, never between visits.
transparency.liveLocation: Where you are during working hours — only if you agree
transparency.liveLocationDetail: Only after you accept the live location notice and start sharing for the day, only in your working hours, and only while the app is on your screen: your position about every 5 minutes. Kept 90 days from when your company received it, then deleted. Withdraw any time from Me.
transparency.visits: Which doctors you saw, and when
transparency.voiceNotesDetail: Only while you hold the button. Marked for deletion 90 days after they reach your company.
transparency.reports: Your reports, and what you left
transparency.reportsDetail: The call reports you send and the samples you record, in your words.
transparency.recordings: Recordings — only if a doctor agrees
transparency.recordingsDetail: Only after the doctor agrees on screen, each time.

liveTracking.noNotice: There is no notice to read yet.
liveTracking.draftTitle: DRAFT — not approved by your company
liveTracking.draftDetail: This is a draft notice, shown so live location can be tried. Your company has not approved it, and parts of it are still blank.
liveTracking.switchedOff: Your company has live location switched off.
liveTracking.withdrawFailed: Your withdrawal did not reach your company
liveTracking.withdrawFailedDetail: Nothing changed. Try again when you have signal.
liveTracking.agree: I have read this notice and agree

liveTracking.supersededDetail: The new version is shown above. Read it before you agree.
liveTracking.agreeFailed: Your agreement did not reach your company
liveTracking.agreeFailedDetail: Nothing was recorded. Try again when you have signal.
onboarding.locationHeadline: Stop filling in where you were.
onboarding.locationLead: Turn location on and two things stop being your job.
onboarding.locationOneTapDetail: Press the button and where you were is recorded with it. No writing the clinic name into a form in the waiting room.
onboarding.locationMileageDetail: Distance between the visits you checked into goes onto your claim. It is measured in straight lines, so it under-counts real roads rather than over-counting them.
onboarding.locationOnlyPress: Only when you press check in or check out
onboarding.locationOnlyPressDetail: Not in the background, not while you walk, not after your shift. This app never asks your phone for a position at any other moment.
onboarding.locationOn: Location is on. Your check-ins will record where you were.
onboarding.locationUnanswered: The phone did not show the question. Nothing has changed; you can try again, or carry on — everything works without location.
onboarding.deniedHeadline: Location is off, so you're doing this by hand
onboarding.deniedBody: Check-ins need a tap each and mileage won't add itself up. That's about 14 minutes a day and roughly ₹600 a month you'd claim manually.
onboarding.deniedEstimate: Estimates from the product design, not measured from your visits.
onboarding.stillOff: Location is still off. You can carry on by hand — everything works.
onboarding.unanswered: The phone did not show the question. Nothing has changed.
onboarding.notifDayPlanDetail: When tomorrow's visits are ready, and when a manager changes them.
onboarding.notifSyncDetail: Only when something you sent was refused and needs you to look at it.
onboarding.notifConsentDetail: When a recording you made is confirmed, or when consent was withdrawn.
onboarding.notifCoachingDetail: When your manager leaves a note on one of your visits.
onboarding.capOne: At most {cap} a day, and nothing outside this one.
onboarding.capTwo: At most {cap} a day, and nothing outside these two.
onboarding.capThree: At most {cap} a day, and nothing outside these three.
onboarding.capFour: At most {cap} a day, and nothing outside these four.
onboarding.capMany: At most {cap} a day, and nothing outside these {cap}.
onboarding.micHeadline: Your note, in your own words
onboarding.micNote: Your note is yours. It records only while you hold the button, and it stops the moment you let go.
onboarding.micSeparate: Recording a consultation is a different thing. That needs the doctor to agree, every time, and you will be asked about it there — not here.
onboarding.couldNotOpen: Could not open {destination} on this phone. The steps above still work.
onboarding.videoNote: It will appear here once it has been recorded. The steps above work without it.
onboarding.xiaomiHeadline: Xiaomi will shut this app off. Two taps stops it.
onboarding.xiaomiConsequence: If MIUI closes the app, your check-ins and mileage stop and you'll be entering them by hand.
onboarding.seeXiaomiBattery: Battery saver / No restrictions. Tap the last one, then press back.
onboarding.oppoHeadline: ColorOS is the strictest of the four.
onboarding.oppoConsequence: Three settings in three different places. Worth doing once — otherwise the app dies in your pocket within the hour.
onboarding.seeOppoBattery: Smart power saving / Allow background activity
onboarding.vivoHeadline: Vivo hides this under 'High background power'.
onboarding.vivoConsequence: The setting sounds like a warning. It isn't — it's permission to keep running while you walk between clinics.
onboarding.seeVivoBattery: High background power use. Switch it on, then press back twice.
onboarding.realmeHeadline: Two settings, same screen. Quickest of the four.
onboarding.realmeConsequence: Realme puts both in one place. Tap through and you're done in about fifteen seconds.
onboarding.genericHeadline: Stop Android putting this app to sleep.
onboarding.genericConsequence: If the phone sleeps the app, your check-ins and mileage stop and you'll be entering them by hand.
onboarding.stepGenericBattery: Allow the app to run in the background
onboarding.seeGenericBattery: Battery optimisation. Find this app in the list and allow it.
onboarding.stepGenericStart: Check the app is allowed to start on its own
onboarding.seeGenericStart: App info. The wording differs by phone.
onboarding.notSetUp: This copy of the app is not set up
onboarding.notSetUpDetail: It was built without the address of the server, so it cannot sign you in or send anything. Nothing is being recorded. Tell whoever gave you this app; it needs to be built again.

visit.witnessedDeclined: The doctor said no to recording, on this phone at {at}.
visit.witnessedNotAsked: Recording was not asked about, on this phone at {at}.
